text:
Zoe: Pixel Party Friday? Thinking LAN in the lounge 6:30pm. I'll bring my Steam Deck + a router for a private LAN, and a box of spare Steam keys (co-op puzzle/platformers). Anyone up for Mario Kart / Broforce / Move or Die? :video_game:

Arjun: love this. I can bring my PC and a monitor. also a docked Switch if folks want Mario Kart.

Priya: can we do a short indie rotation? I vote for Move or Die and Spelunky 2. Also I can bring bubble tea. :tea:

Ben: count me in. can only stay until ~9:30pm. i have an ethernet switch if we need more ports.

Clara: I have a Steam Controller and an OG Xbox pad adapter. also will bring an extension cord.

Zoe: awesome. rough plan: set up lobby on the Deck, physical LAN for low-latency Smash-esque stuff, then rotate to controllers/indies. low-pressure, drop-in.

Priya: snacks idea: tater tots + spicy mayo? (this is a serious proposal)

Arjun: yes to tots. i will bring plates.

Ben: remote option? might join from home for a couple rounds of Rocket League or Overcooked via Remote Play.

Zoe: remote totally fine. we'll run a Steam Remote Play Together room and post the link here.

ops-bot: Room reservation: Lounge A approved 6:00pm-10:00pm. AV note: "TV + HDMI + power strip" requested.

Zoe: ops-bot thanks! TV + HDMI is perfect. Who can bring a dock for the Switch?

Clara: I have a dock and 2 joy-cons.

Priya: i'll label the drinks "Pixel Party Fuel" so they survive the warm office. :sweat_smile:

Arjun: quick poll: who can come in person? reply yes/no. (Ben maybe leaves early)

Zoe: Yes.

Arjun: Yes.

Priya: Yes.

Clara: Yes.

Ben: Partial (til 9:30).

Zoe: Great. I'll post the Steam room link + playlist tomorrow. If anyone has a portable speaker, please bring it; soundbot will be sad otherwise. :speaker:

soundbot: auto-playlist queued: "Lo-fi lunch" -> "8-bit bangers" -> "chill synth".

Zoe: perfect. see ya Friday for the Pixel Party. no esports pressure, just chaos and snacks. :joystick:
